JUDGEMENT CALLS:
* S28 (518,533) - the only genuine 4-way crossing on the sheet, deg=5. Pixel dump (inkmap 518,533) shows the x~518 column running unbroken from y=511 to y=555 and the horizontal wire running unbroken left-to-right; no semicircular hop, no sideways jog, and the ink at the meeting point is a fattened blob (~7x9 px against a ~3 px stroke, dot metric 2.1, the same score as the unambiguous T at S8). Read as JUNCTION. The alternative (crossing) would split the mid net into {op-amp #15 out, L#13 right, R#12 left} and a second net {in+ of op-amp #3, left plate of C#18} that has no driver at all - a floating two-terminal island between an op-amp input and a capacitor plate. The drafter uses hops/jogs elsewhere in this dataset for 'not connected' and drew none here, so junction on both the electrical and the ink prior.
* All other CRITICAL sites are unambiguous T-junctions (a wire ending on another wire), confirmed one by one in the 5x crops: S8 (240,220) V-DC rail meets the C#0 riser and op-amp #2 in-; S11 (499,255) C#0 right lead drops onto the op-amp #2 output wire; S12 (648,263) R#4 right end meets the L#1 riser and op-amp #3 in-; S13 (850,282) op-amp #3 output meets the L#1 drop and R#5; S27 (440,528) the y~528 wire meets the drop to op-amp #15 output; S29 (673,533) R#12 right end meets the C#9 riser and op-amp #11 in-; S30 (847,542) op-amp #11 output meets the C#9 drop and R#10; S31 (990,542) R#10 right end lands on the right rail (visible solder blob, dot=2.6); S47 (655,802) C#18 right end meets the L#16 riser and op-amp #19 in-; S48 (838,830) op-amp #19 output meets the L#16 drop and R#21. Each was recorded as junction; a crossing reading at any of them would strand a component lead on a one-terminal net.

PORT / PIN FIXES:
* C#0 and C#9: the tracer had terminal t0 pointing at stray ink of the '1uF' label above the symbol (p2), leaving nets n1/n8 with a single terminal. Repointed to the real left/right plate leads (p0/p1).
* All five op-amps needed a pin-order fix; the tracer's port order is geometric, not electrical. Every op-amp on this sheet is drawn with '-' on the upper input and '+' on the lower input (verified in each _comps_ crop), apex lead = output. Final mapping is t0=in+, t1=in-, t2=out for #2 (t0=p2,t1=p1,t2=p0), #3 (t0=p0,t1=p1,t2=p2), #11 (t0=p2,t1=p1,t2=p0), #15 (t0=p2,t1=p1,t2=p0), #19 (t0=p2,t1=p1,t2=p0).

No class corrections: every symbol matches its COCO label. No unconnected leads, no forced merges, no dropped bridges. ERC clean.
